**Main line:** Nxf3+ Kh1 hxg2#

**Motif:** fork (the knight forks king and knight) / intermezzo (forcing check that breaks the pin and wins material leading to mate)

**Explanation (coaching note):**

When your knight is attacked, look for forcing moves—especially checks. Here, **Nxf3+** forces the king to h1, then your pawn delivers checkmate on g2. The key insight: a check can be tactical gold if it solves your immediate problem (the loose knight) while creating a worse one for your opponent. Always scan for forcing sequences when under pressure.
